title: Navy pilots interviewed, including Fravor and Dietrich of the 2004 Tic Tac case
place_text: Off the coast of the United States

tellings.quote: Skinwalker Ranch. Uh we interviewed Navy pilots uh a succession of them. We also [clears throat] found Dave Fraver and Alex Dietrich who had been pilots in the Tic Tac episode back in 2004.

plain: A former US Senate staffer named Kirk McConnell says that while looking into strange reports, including ones tied to Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch famous for tales of odd happenings, his team interviewed a series of Navy pilots. Among them, he says, were David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, two pilots from the 2004 Tic Tac episode, when Navy fliers off the US coast reported a white oval object shaped like the mint. Their accounts matter to him because trained military pilots are hard witnesses to dismiss.
